source_note: 18 distinct Cu-Al-Ni studies; paper-specific observations, independently testable numeric/structural invariants, and strict refusal of underidentified full Cayron twin-supercompatibility comparisons
method: Every paper is a separate evidence gate. Source-explicit quantities are checked against independent physical/metric calculations where sufficient; otherwise the executable gate asserts NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FOR_FULL_EQ42. Passing a gate means correct handling of what the paper supports, not full empirical validation.

papers.title: Hane and Shield, Microstructure in a copper-aluminium-nickel shape-memory alloy

observables.habit_vector_cubic_symmetry_note: Source vectors are parent cubic Cartesian and may differ by cubic signed-permutation variant labels; compare projective symmetry-invariant sorted absolute directions, not componentwise arbitrary gauge.

papers.limitation: Source gives cubic-to-orthorhombic stretch construction and predicted twin/habit values, but not a validated phase-specific app ProjectState C in this entry.
papers.required_action: Obtain exact source-defined C and matched parent/product metrics, twin/habit 3D frames, uncertainty and specimen identity before Eq42/CC123 acceptance.
